releases.body:
- Updated the skills, README, and publishing checklist for MrScraper MCP
  server 0.5.0, which follows the MrScraper Integrations Standard. The server
  has seven tools with the standard descriptions: `status`, `scrapeHtml`,
  `scrapeMarkdown`, `getScreenshot`, `scrapeBrand`, `scrapeJson`, and
  `webSearch`. `scraperAPI` is gone; use `scrapeHtml`, `scrapeMarkdown`, or
  `getScreenshot`, and `scrapeBrand` or `scrapeJson` for brand data and JSON
  extraction. `webSearch` now takes `query`, `country`, and `numResults`
  instead of `url`, `region`, `num_results`, and `timeout`, and all tool
  inputs are camelCase. Skills are identical to the MrScraper Claude 0.4.0,
  Cursor 0.5.0, Grok 0.4.0, and Antigravity 0.4.0 plugins.
- The hosted server now uses two OAuth scopes: `scrape:read` for the six
  scraping and search tools and `account:read` for `status`. Connections that
  already hold `scrape:read` keep working; `scrape:write` is no longer needed.

- Updated the `mrscraper-serp` skill for MrScraper MCP server 0.3.0, which
  moved `webSearch` to MrScraper's new web search endpoint. Results are a
  ranked list (rank, title, url, description, source); `region` sets the
  results' country and the new `num_results` asks for 10 to 100 results. The
  `raw`, `format`, `language`, `page`, and `render_js` options are gone, and
  so is the search results URL example. Skills are identical to the MrScraper
  Claude plugin 0.3.0.

npm: `@mrscraper/opencode@0.4.0` (shasum `7290660a70550b6fa4a2611864dd43f08bc04b68`).

- Reworded search as web search in the package description, keywords, README, and skills. The `webSearch` tool is unchanged. The skills now differ from the MrScraper Claude plugin 0.2.2 only in this wording.

npm: `@mrscraper/opencode@0.3.2` (shasum `ffff40c7aef103827fdb3b83ebc770064a05dda6`).

- Updated the `mrscraper` skill for the hosted server's three scopes: `scraperAPI` needs `scrape:write`, `webSearch` needs `scrape:read`, and `status` needs `account:read`. If `scraperAPI` returns 403 `insufficient_scope`, run `opencode mcp auth mrscraper` again so OpenCode requests `scrape:write`. Skills are identical to the MrScraper Claude plugin 0.2.2.

npm: `@mrscraper/opencode@0.3.1` (shasum `0077cc1e7c9a4b6b18b59febbf091b0cd8c6416a`).

- Updated the skills for the hosted MCP server's new tools: `scraperAPI` (pages as HTML, Markdown, or screenshots), `webSearch` (Google), and `status` (account usage). The `fetch`, `scrape`, `serp`, `rerun`, `results`, and `result` tools no longer exist.
- Removed the `mrscraper-scrape` skill. Skills are identical to the MrScraper Claude plugin 0.2.0.

npm: `@mrscraper/opencode@0.3.0` (shasum `69212add273b7b170d18c5281d9e842c69e07819`).
